notes: One hunter pursuing everyone else through a shared map is the 1 vs All layout, kept on its own warren-looping shape: the city blocks, streets and tunnels have to loop with no dead end, because being cornered by a pathfinding NPC with no counterplay is the failure this shape exists to prevent, and that P6 is structural. Dropped the preset's gate-escape, since the answers make the loop endless with distance as the only score and an exit would break that, and dropped spawn-protected, since Invincible is an NPC rather than a player and everyone starts from the same point. Considered Infinite Runner for the endless distance scoring but rejected it: forward motion is player-controlled across a fixed few blocks rather than automatic over procedural chunks. Decided without a user that the tunnels are at-grade underpasses rather than stacked layers, keeping it off P2, and that the checkpoints, coin economy and warning system are progression and UI with no layout row here.
